changes.label: Organization membership
changes.statement: Users may belong to multiple organizations and select one active organization.

changes.label: Switch active organization
changes.statement: User → choose organization → switch request → backend membership validation → active organization changes.

changes.label: Backend organization authorization
changes.statement: Backend authorization is authoritative; the server verifies organization membership before switching active organization.

changes.label: Frontend switch is convenience
changes.statement: Frontend organization switching is a convenience and cannot replace backend membership checks.
